notes.title: Little Rocket Lab Releases OCTOBER 7TH!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, everyone! Are you ready for liftoff?[/h3][h1][b]We’re so excited to announce that Little Rocket Lab is coming on OCTOBER 7TH![/b] [/h1][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/94e677c3e9735861a94c9c03a31072d5af025746.png"][/img]
[/h3][h3]It’s time to dust off those trusty hammers and head back to your childhood hometown and shoot for the stars![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451100/Little_Rocket_Lab/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/85b287c55fe03e7dc80a91b3eac5439ee9a62ac5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]St Ambroise is finally ready to welcome you back with open arms! You’ll need to research and build clever contraptions and sprawling factories to help the locals, from simple drills and furnaces to complex assemblers, then meet old friends and make new ones to fully restore the town! Are you ready to finish your Mother’s dream and build a rocket?[/h3][h3]
Thank you so much to those of you who've shown an interest, chatted to us, kept Auntie company on [url="https://discord.gg/VEQ2edQmH6"]Discord[/url], and read our dev updates - it's been an amazing journey. We cannot WAIT to see what you all think come October 7th!
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/73cdc072a116cb2d42e65614914c1cf79a2aecb9.png"][/img][/p][h3]
Not long to go now!

Teenage Astronauts & No More Robots xoxo[/h3]

notes.title: Loyal Companions
notes.content:
Hey again, everyone! We’ve got something a little different for you this week. St. Ambroise is packed with quirky townsfolk and curious characters, but four in particular are always ready to go the extra mile. Meet Morgan’s loyal companions!

🎮 Want to meet them yourself? The playtest is live now—come say hello!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451100/Little_Rocket_Lab/

[hr][/hr]

[h3]📺 Pico – The TV[/h3]

Morgan built Pico from her aunt’s old television when she was just a kid, he might not pick up many channels anymore… but what he lacks in reception, he more than makes up for in personality. Ever the optimist, Pico’s a positive, encouraging friend who’s always cheering Morgan on. He’s not much of a long-term planner, but he’s 100% here for the journey. You’ll usually find him hanging around the courtyard of the old factory, watching Morgan work. Just try not to make him too involved in the factory itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/4727974a36e1380f0771e2561deba79f0990c7fa.png[/img]
[h3]🧺 Scrubs – The Washing Machine[/h3]

Once destined for the scrap heap, Scrubs got a second chance when Morgan spotted a little life still left in this beat-up old washer. After all, if she could build one cheerful companion, why not another?

Well… turns out Scrubs may have spent a bit too long cleaning other people’s dirty laundry. Fairly grumpy, definitely rude, and happiest doing his own thing... though his own thing seems to involve making Morgan’s socks go missing. He may not be the warmest spin cycle on the block, but he’s part of the team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/2794ee031fe21c7f95e4b8ccbea2bfac44fe0ed5.png[/img]
[h3]🍞 Toasty – The Toaster Utility Vehicle[/h3]

Standing at a mighty eight feet tall, Toasty is exactly what it says on the label: a walking toaster with a love of bread recipes and a knack for destruction. He’s been missing for a bit, but this toaster packs a serious punch, being able to tear up old factory equipment to make way for new plans, or just tearing across the landscape. He’s a true friend, and a sweet ride. Though auntie really does wish Morgan would stop building robots out of her appliances!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/45e94e8fe3f1fe7911ee855b4f815e2088cb36f3.png[/img]
[h3]🐶 Leo – The Good Boy[/h3]

Leo can’t seem to find his way home, but he did find his way to Morgan’s doorstep, and that’s all that matters. The bond was instant, and now this very good boy is by Morgan’s side through thick and thin. Whether it’s sniffing out townsfolk, chasing a ball, or enjoying some well-earned ear scritches, Leo’s everyone’s best friend. Except for birds. The birds know what they did.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/d633878a1a2fbf659cfaad1064736094cdce07e0.png[/img]
That’s all for now, but we’ll be introducing more of St. Ambroise’s residents soon... maybe even a few with just as much personality as this lot! Got a favourite already? Come tell us over on Discord! We’d love to know who’s claimed your heart (or your socks).

—

 Teenage Astronauts and No More Robots

 xoxo 🚀

notes.title: See The Sights
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Our "How to Get Started" series may be wrapped, but we’re not done showing you around just yet. Come take a tour of St. Ambroise as we head off the beaten path and explore everything this delightful town has to offer.

🎮 Want to see it all for yourself? Join the playtest now and see if you can track down all these spots!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451100/Little_Rocket_Lab/
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Oh, We Do Like to Be Beside the Seaside[/h3]

We’re kicking things off at the docks, where the lighthouse (like much of the town) has definitely seen better days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/cc17eff1a77d00b1141b35745b91a971b053bf89.png[/img]
It will definitely take a little elbow grease and some good old-fashioned hard work, but we reckon you could have this beauty up and running again in no time.

The port’s looking a little empty for now, but if only the waters were safer... maybe there’s hope for incoming shipments yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/5baeda23efbafc14b274c1afc3916fa0d115040a.png[/img]
[h3]Back to Town[/h3]

We could easily spend a whole post talking about all the houses in town (and hey, maybe we will!) but for now, here are a few must-see highlights:

🕍 Head down south to check out the church! Maybe take a moment to reflect before you go back to your mad science and factory chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/bf55e1ce6d07f597420737e3216cbe8f89cc1b8c.png[/img]
🎓 The university might just become your second home. This is where you’ll do your research by supplying the team with materials to cook up shiny new tech.

[i]What do you mean it's closed on Sundays?! Don’t they know we’ve got research to do?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/c5262c0ae92021a415415e61220a470cff20d787.png[/img]
🍰Jamie’s Cakes & Confectionaries is the perfect place for a quick break, and it’s fully stocked with caffeine-filled wonder drinks for a much-needed boost. Priorities, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/3de19c14e1530a1929c1c654a37400314596b43f.png[/img]
[h3]On the Peripheries[/h3]

There’s plenty to see just outside of town too. Here are a few of our favourite spots:

⚡ The Hydro Dam – Looks like there might be some potential here... Maybe we won’t need that 50th wind turbine after all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/1304de002b9879930bcab3a36ddf758f3b897f66.png[/img]
🔭 The Observatory – Make the trek up the mountain past the dam and you’ll find this gorgeous spot. A great place to look out over the countryside, and who knows, maybe we can get that telescope working again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/a1adfdc179c4f647c7d71d9b649ca13025d08af9.png[/img]
🚂 The Railyard – It’s a bit run down at the moment, and we can’t quite figure out what all that machinery is for… But with a little time, maybe we’ll finally get our hands on all that ore rolling through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/0386ddf0b41b3b9f44bbeaa440838931447a153d.png[/img]
🚀 The Rocket Silo – We couldn’t end this tour without stopping by the silo. It’ll take a heap of time and a mountain of resources to bring this giant back online, but we believe in you. Just… maybe don’t tell Auntie what you’re up to. We’re looking at you, Pico.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/8ed738b29bb1d4a50b5232ff505edf57bc4dcd96.png[/img]
And that’s it for our whistle-stop tour of St. Ambroise! What would you like to see next? Let us know by joining the Discord! We’d love to hear from you and see what you’ve been building!
—
Teenage Astronauts and No More Robots
xoxo 🚀

notes.title: Time to Expand
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We’re back with our final getting started guide for Little Rocket Lab! Today, we’re upgrading our setup and branching out, splitting resources into multiple production lines so you can make a little bit of everything without breaking a sweat.

🎮 Want to try it out yourself? The playtest is live right now! And don’t forget to wishlist while you’re there so you’re all set for takeoff!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451100/Little_Rocket_Lab/

[hr][/hr]

We’re heading back to our trusty build site just next to the university, and this time we’re bringing upgrades. Let’s get those Level 2 furnaces running hot and start expanding our production lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/4c38c0d5c16ec8d9ee6bbbcdc8560b112061898e.png[/img]
💡 [b]Wondering how we set those up?[/b]

Catch last week’s news post for the full breakdown!

By now, you’ve probably noticed that basic resources like plates and gears are essential building blocks for more complex items… buuuut you still need those basics for other recipes too.
So what’s the trick to sharing resources without duplicating every single line?

[b]Item receivers and splitters[/b] to the rescue!

Let’s look at bearings and gears, two key ingredients in small motors, which you’re already producing anyway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/db002070c9774dd3942019b2375d65676fe82023.png[/img]
Set a splitter to grab every second item off the belts and send it down a new conveyor for further crafting, while the rest keeps heading toward your receiver. Easy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/3510ed67963f708b9f068d3007d2317f94d9f334.png[/img]
Now is also a great time to start automating the production of your commonly used factory parts.

We’re adding lines for conveyors and assemblers, both of which use steel plates as a base.

The setup is super simple, just remember, splitters should be configured to leave items on the belt, otherwise you'll find yourself coming up short somewhere else! Play around with the splitter ratios and see what works best for your situation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/3d0b01ac8318bdddb97bbc8df10c3ccf2f611dda.png[/img]
Is this the most efficient layout? Absolutely not.
Is it a solid starting point you can improve on and optimise later? You bet!

[h3]That’s a Wrap on Level 2![/h3]

Don’t stop there! Add in more splitters throughout your factory to divert other resources like copper wire and heatsinks into storage. That way, you’ve always got the parts you need, when you need them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/33f75c70c888d8c04302d8382765797a31de7d22.png[/img]
Is it tidy? Nope. Does it work? Heck yeah, it does.

Thanks for sticking with us through the early game! We can’t wait to see what kind of logistical wizardry you’ll build next.

As always, come hang out with us on Discord and show off your factories, we’d love to see them!
—
Teenage Astronauts and No More Robots
 xoxo 🚀

notes.title: Crank Up the Heat!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Time for another quick guide to Little Rocket Lab’s early game! Today, we’re diving into Level 2 Furnaces and how to keep them fueled with coal and ore like a pro.

Don’t forget, you can play Little Rocket Lab right now by joining the Playtest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451100/Little_Rocket_Lab/

[hr][/hr]

[h3]No More Shoveling![/h3]

With your [b]small motor[/b] line chugging away, it’s time to upgrade your factory and kick your automation game into high gear. And how do we do that?

Say hello to [b]Level 2 Furnaces![/b] These beauties let you feed in both ore and coal via conveyor belts, which means no more running around manually inputting coal.

You’ll want [b]at least three furnaces[/b] each for both [b]iron[/b] and [b]copper[/b] bar production. And unless you fancy setting up mini-factories all over town, that means grouping them together in one sleek, central spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/6aff1504a57ec1ba6cff05edaf210228134ffa2f.png[/img]
[b]All that in one place?![/b]

We get it. Lining up multiple furnaces with ore and coal inputs can look a bit... intense. You’re imagining criss-crossing belts, overlapping lines, chaos at every turn. But don’t panic! We’ve got a simple setup to get you going without the headache.

You’ve already met your new best friend, the [b]underpass[/b], but now it’s time to add [b]splitters[/b] to your repertoire (aka robot arms for the old-school crowd).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/041a0a463e84f6ea1732c8ded1189ce65adf7e8e.png[/img]

First up: [b]coal[/b]. Bring it on separate lines, and use underpasses to leave a gap in your layout, trust us, you’ll need it.

[b]Pro tip[/b]: underpasses can’t feed machines directly, so leave room for at least one conveyor to drop off the goods.

Next, run your [b]copper belt[/b] through that lovely gap. Nice and tidy. But wait! It’s only feeding the last furnace in the row. Not ideal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/6b22899ed73637d497b41e43d3d73a7b8d2b4251.png[/img]
[h3]Enter: Splitters[/h3]

Add [b]two splitters[/b] to pull from the copper belt and distribute the goods evenly to all three furnaces. One belt, three machines, no problem.

Just remember: like underpasses, [b]splitters also need a bit of room[/b]—they drop items onto a belt, which then carries them into the furnace. So don’t cram them too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/f6fa3dd585289245ecfa2a0519c6c2a7af1b19ce.png[/img]
To ensure that our splitters aren’t stealing too many of the resources, we need to configure them!

Start by setting the [b]first splitter[/b] to grab [i]every third item[/i], this lets two copper ore cruise past it on the main belt. Then, set the [b]second splitter[/b] to grab [i]every second item[/i]. That way, one copper ore gets through each time for the final furnace.

With that setup, your ore gets split evenly between all three furnaces, no bottlenecks, and no sudden lack of copper on one of your production lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/79bcf233b811ba22b7f8d7585edf3472c1310e65.png[/img]
From here, go wild. See how far you can push your setup, add more furnaces, spin off extra production lines, or go push yourself to limit and optimise every machine down the line.

Here’s a little extra set up we made earlier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/7c74184b841cdd8d82eda67d76f6f5702ce10e96.png[/img]
Most importantly: have fun, and don’t forget to share your creations with us! We love seeing your factory masterpieces and mad hat creations!

Teenage Astronauts and No More Robots
xoxo

notes.title: Scaling Up
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 

Welcome back to another handy guide for Little Rocket Lab! Today, we’re diving into Level 2 research and showing you how to take your factory game to the next level, with even more automation and a whole lot of conveyor belts!

Want to try it out for yourself? Join the playtest! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451100/Little_Rocket_Lab/]It’s available to play right now on our Steam page! [/url]While you’re there, don’t forget to hit the wishlist button so you’re prepped for takeoff!

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Level 2, Let’s Go![/h3]

Alright, so you’ve made it to Level 2 research.. nice! Time to crank things up a notch. The good news? We’re starting simple.

Over on the iron side of things, just one extra line will do the trick for now. All you need to add is:

[b]Coal + Iron → Iron Bars → Iron Plates → Bearings[/b]

That’s it! Clean, easy, and ready to roll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/f018caedfa21729fc8c78644e53d4100bd053a17.png[/img]

[h3]Keepin’ It Cool with Copper[/h3]

Our copper setup is even easier. All we’re adding is a line to create heatsinks:

[b]Copper Ore → Copper Bars → Heatsinks[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/e43295042aa0edcedcf6fbd1ed5f38d31c38cfb1.png[/img]

Once you’ve turned in those shiny new heatsinks, you’ll unlock [b]Level 2 Assemblers[/b], and trust us, this is where the automation really kicks up a notch. They let you combine two components into something even more complex!

[h3]Small But Mighty[/h3]

To progress, we need to craft small motors, and that means using a couple Level 2 assemblers in a row. The line looks like this:

[b]Gear + Copper Wire → Stator
Stator + Bearing → Small Motor[/b]

It should look a little something like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/faf6e73e4fa0894dd3f5c0049862b5ff70192c6d.png[/img]

Now, if you’ve been paying attention, you might spot a couple of hiccups right away. Sure, getting [b]gears[/b] to the assembler is easy with a conveyor belt, but how about [b]copper wire[/b]? That’s across the road.

And look, we can’t go turning every street into a conveyor highway. People have places to be!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/862b5944ed98af1a45c5182ae2bab3d4ae383c22.png[/img]

[h3]Time for an Underpass![/h3]

Luckily, we’ve got a trick up our sleeve: the [b]underpass[/b]! Drop one of these bad boys in and you can run your copper wire under the road, no traffic jams required. Just like that, your [b]stator[/b] production is good to go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/175e0793fc30159b6709ecfe270e26ae01ce2c5a.png[/img]

Next up the [b]bearings[/b]. But uh-oh, the route’s blocked by other conveyor belts. No stress! We’ve got more underpasses! Angle your bearing belt so it ducks under the existing machinery, link it up to your assembler on the other side, and voilà: small motor production is officially online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/f3234fcea45b02ffb5308c212534716ff4bf0d89.png[/img]

With that all set, your small motor line is humming along nicely and you’re ready for what’s next!

Join us next time where we’ll talk about really ramping things up using splitters and level 2 furnaces! 


We hope you’ve enjoyed this little dive into the wonderful world of early-game automation in Little Rocket Lab! We’d love to see your factory creations too! Come hang out with us on [url=https://discord.gg/N4WSa4T5FC]Discord[/url] and share your setups!

We’ll be back soon with another sneak peek, stay tuned! 👀

Teenage Astronauts and No More Robots
xoxo

notes.title: Demo Update & Getting in Gear
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 

We hope you’ve been having a blast with the playtest! And if you haven’t jumped in yet... what are you waiting for? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451100/Little_Rocket_Lab/]It’s available to play right now on the store page![/url] Don’t forget to Wishlist us while you’re there so you’re all set for launch! 🚀

Huge thanks to everyone who's been testing the game so far! We've already added loads of tweaks and shiny new features, here’s a look at what's new in the latest version:
[list]
[*] Robot arms have been renamed to splitters and can now split belts at a configurable ratio.
[*] You can now set a limit for how many items a receiver will accept.
[*] Powerlines are automatically removed and re-added when placing new power poles and wind turbines.
[*] Wind turbines now show their current efficiency.
[*] Arrow keys are now listed on the rebinding screen.
[/list]

Whether you’re a seasoned pro starting fresh or just got off the train to town, we’ve put together a quick guide to help you hit the ground running—check it out below! 👇

[hr][/hr]

Want to get those conveyor belts rolling out even faster? Keen to fill your inventory with iron plates without all the handcrafting? You’re in the right place! This guide has everything you need to get through Level 1 research and kick-start your journey to mega-automation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/a3e393dab2d799990353070fdb4a1f664eeaf16e.gif[/img]

[u][b]Location, Location[/b][/u]

The town is packed with promising spots, each brimming with resources ready to fuel your dream factory. So… where should you set up shop?

Totally your call, but we [i]love[/i] that cozy little area right next to the university. Why? Because [b]less walking = more progress![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/14e6cee9e4fc6a95f5108ce4f794e6c80cbe378b.png[/img]

After helping out your aunt with her chaotic front yard, pack up your gear and head on over to your chosen spot. Or hey, stick around her place if you’re feeling lazy. We’re not your boss.

[u][b]Ironing out the basics[/b][/u]

Early game, you’ll need a lot of just a few key resources. Getting these production lines running ASAP will save you serious grind time.

We recommend two core production lines:
[list]
[*] Coal +Iron → Iron Bars → Iron Plates
[*] Coal +Iron → Iron Bars → Iron Plates → Gears 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/85b391535f8736dbdca01afe87419d782d19f351.png[/img]

This little setup is your golden ticket to better tech… like drills! Once you get your hands on them, get those drills on your iron and coal, and let the automation magic begin. (Just remember to keep those furnaces fueled, old-school style, with a little manual coal delivery.)

Tips:
[list]
[*] Build long conveyors! You’ll thank yourself when it’s time to expand.
[*] Keep layouts compact. More space for more upgrades and new lines down the road!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/561cae2de18c9125148e332a774acfd984995652.png[/img]

[u][b]Power to the people![/b][/u]

Running low on juice? Time to wire things up. That means you’ll need lots of copper wire!

Lucky for you, the copper deposits are just across the road. Set up your drills and furnaces like before, but this time, you only need one output. So one assembler is plenty!

[b]Pro Tip:[/b] A single assembler can make copper wire twice as fast if you feed it copper bars from two furnaces! Apply this to your iron plates and gears as well for a sneaky efficiency boost. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/b7cb6a8d666380c8ad9897fe7c79c58c91bfa2e9.png[/img]

[u][b]Ready to Rock[/b][/u]

You’re almost ready to take on the world! Just one more thing: [b]stone[/b]. Arguably the simplest resource of all, but just as essential.

Find yourself a big ol’ rock (a mineable one, preferably). There are plenty of them around your aunt’s place if you’re indecisive. Set up a few drills, toss on some power and storage, and you’re good to go!

Tip: The earlier you have a conveyor belt from your stone to the university the better. Don't say we didn’t warn you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340546/69de6e43b7fe868c383068c1d0899f6588662058.png[/img]

[u][b]Over to you![/b][/u]

And there you have it! Your very first step into the world of efficient production lines and factory design. With that you’re all set up to complete tier one! 

Remember: this is just one of [i]many[/i] ways to play. Rather build back at home base and huff it on foot? Go for it. Prefer to automate the entire town? We respect that. The important thing? Have fun and build it [i]your way[/i].

Teenage Astronauts and No More Robots
xoxo
